title: Fizz Buzz
problem: Given a positive integer N on a single line of input, print the numbers from 1 to N, one per line. For multiples of 3 print "Fizz" instead of the number, for multiples of 5 print "Buzz", and for multiples of both 3 and 5 print "FizzBuzz".

hints.1: Think about checking "both 3 and 5" before checking either one alone.
hints.2: Check divisibility by 15 first (both 3 and 5), then 3, then 5, then fall back to the number itself - order matters.

failure_explanation: Checking i % 3 == 0 before i % 15 == 0 means multiples of 15 only ever print 'Fizz' and never reach the 'FizzBuzz' case - check the combined condition (divisible by both 3 and 5) first, then the single conditions.
